body: Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.
plain_description: **Track and improve the quality of your AI applications and agents.** Opik helps teams review traces, evaluate outputs, and monitor applications in production. Self-host it in your own environment or use Comet’s cloud service.
technical_description: Opik is an open-source platform for LLM observability, evaluation, prompt management, and AI agent tracing. It captures traces through Python and TypeScript SDKs, OpenTelemetry, and framework integrations; supports datasets, experiments, LLM-as-a-judge metrics, and online evaluation; and provides dashboards for production monitoring. Deploy with Docker Compose or Kubernetes, or use Comet Cloud.
title: Opik
